audience: Customers, partners, executives, architects, delivery teams, and assurance reviewers

milestones.title: Source-Faithful Local Oracle
milestones.customer_value: Creates a trustworthy local reference for one real CardDemo business process so modernization output can be compared against preserved legacy behavior.
deliverables: A cross-platform Python oracle for the INTCALC batch workload.
Fixed-width CardDemo record parsing and COBOL signed-zoned-decimal support.
Deterministic account and transaction outputs with a hashed evidence receipt.
A candidate comparator that reports exact business-field differences.
A source-faithful policy that preserves the discovered final-account edge case.
boundaries: The oracle is derived from source and is not independent proof of z/OS behavior.
VSAM locking, JES, Language Environment behavior, and EBCDIC collation are not emulated.
Production equivalence requires corroborating authorized legacy execution evidence.

milestones.title: Verified Java and Spring Batch Candidate
milestones.customer_value: Proves that a modern implementation can be built and checked automatically against the source-faithful oracle instead of relying on manual code review.
deliverables: An auditable Java 17, Spring Boot, and Spring Batch modernization candidate.
CardDemo-compatible fixed-width input and output codecs.
COBOL overpunch decoding and encoding in the modern implementation.
Unit, packaging, differential, cross-platform, and CI verification paths.
Separation of batch orchestration from the business transformation.
boundaries: Passing the local oracle proves bounded development equivalence, not z/OS equivalence.
The candidate covers the selected INTCALC slice rather than the full CardDemo estate.
Live operational characteristics remain outside the claim.

milestones.title: Evidence-Aware Knowledge Graph
milestones.customer_value: Turns a large legacy estate into a traceable map of programs, data, jobs, dependencies, rules, tests, and source evidence.

milestones.title: Graph Explorer and Neo4j Projection
milestones.customer_value: Makes the modernization graph understandable through visual exploration and a lossless external graph projection.

milestones.title: Evidence-Grounded Graph Chat
milestones.customer_value: Lets users ask plain-language questions about a legacy estate while requiring answers to cite retrieved graph evidence and state their limitations.

milestones.title: Relationship and Source Evidence Intelligence
milestones.customer_value: Explains why every important dependency exists and links it back to bounded source context.

milestones.title: Autonomous Factory Run Engine
milestones.customer_value: Introduces controlled planner, builder, and verifier automation with deterministic policy remaining authoritative.

milestones.title: Runtime Evidence Plane
milestones.customer_value: Adds observed runtime evidence to the static estate map and distinguishes observed, contradicted, and static-only claims.

milestones.title: z/OSMF Adapter and Connection Simulator
milestones.customer_value: Creates a secure path for collecting bounded job and spool evidence while keeping simulation visibly separate from real z/OS observation.

milestones.title: Audit Ledger and Evidence Control Tower
milestones.customer_value: Makes modernization decisions, evidence, approvals, exceptions, and release posture tamper-evident and reviewable.

milestones.title: Hardened Admitted Execution
milestones.customer_value: Moves factory execution from policy simulation to signed, identity-bound, constrained container runs.

milestones.title: Model Workcell and Context Control
milestones.customer_value: Controls model cost, context, allowed edits, retries, and evidence so AI assistance remains bounded and reproducible.

milestones.title: Sealed Quality Gates
milestones.customer_value: Separates public calibration from private qualification and makes promotion depend on signed, threshold-based evidence.

milestones.title: Verified Semantic Memory
milestones.customer_value: Allows the factory to reuse evidence-bound experience without allowing stale, failed, or private verifier information to contaminate future work.

milestones.title: Conflict-Aware Portfolio Factory
milestones.customer_value: Coordinates multiple modernization work orders and detects shared-file, dependency, dataset, and scheduling conflicts before execution.

milestones.title: Durable Factory Recovery Control Plane
milestones.customer_value: Makes long-running factory work recoverable across interruption, restart, and controller failure.

milestones.title: Live Evidence Control Tower
milestones.customer_value: Extends the control tower from committed demonstrations to active operational evidence and incident handling.

milestones.title: CICS, VSAM, IMS, and HLASM Readiness Proofs
milestones.customer_value: Establishes bounded logical proof cells for key mainframe technologies before the later full qualification milestones.

milestones.title: DB2 and Multi-Target Data Modernization
milestones.customer_value: Introduces a database modernization proof that can describe DB2 structures and compare more than one target without hard-coding a single destination.

milestones.title: Trusted Extension Evidence Contract
milestones.customer_value: Defines how new language, platform, and adapter capabilities join the factory without bypassing its evidence and trust boundaries.

milestones.title: Mainframe Access Readiness Campaign
milestones.customer_value: Turns separate mainframe connectors into one governed, read-only readiness and capability view.

milestones.title: Mixed PL/I Modernization Proof
milestones.customer_value: Demonstrates a bounded PL/I, COBOL, and DB2 modernization slice with explicit cross-language contracts.

milestones.title: Stable Composite Estate and Developer Golden Path
milestones.customer_value: Stabilizes the semantic inputs used to build the estate graph and gives developers one reproducible verification path.

milestones.title: PL/I Discovery Conformance Lab
milestones.customer_value: Replaces plausible text matching with a bounded, testable PL/I discovery capability and explicit unsupported cases.

milestones.title: Reproducible PL/I Build Attestation
milestones.customer_value: Makes the bounded PL/I candidate build reproducible and binds the artifact to its exact source and toolchain evidence.

milestones.title: Multi-Workload Factory Qualification
milestones.customer_value: Expands factory evaluation beyond one demonstration workload and calibrates qualification across different modernization patterns.

milestones.title: Offline Data Movement and CDC Rehearsal
milestones.customer_value: Adds deterministic change ordering, resume, and data-movement rehearsal before connection to a live replication stream.

milestones.title: Enterprise Collection Appliance
milestones.customer_value: Packages governed source collection and failure testing for customer environments that cannot expose their estate directly.

milestones.title: Governed Source-Only Pilot Intake
milestones.customer_value: Creates a no-network, source-only path for approving and describing a customer pilot before analysis begins.

milestones.title: Customer Source Analysis Workcell
milestones.customer_value: Builds a customer-specific graph and analysis receipt rather than presenting the CardDemo reference graph as customer evidence.

milestones.title: Customer Estate Assessment Planner
milestones.customer_value: Partitions the analyzed estate into coherent application slices and creates an evidence-aware plan without automatically selecting business priorities.

milestones.title: Governed Pilot Work Package
milestones.customer_value: Compiles a human-selected pilot into exact, coordinated development cells with acceptance evidence and blocked live-evidence requirements.

milestones.title: Database Semantic Core
milestones.customer_value: Creates the platform-neutral semantic contract needed to compare database behavior instead of merely generating target DDL.

milestones.title: Oracle-to-PostgreSQL Progressive Proof
milestones.customer_value: Separates the Oracle-to-PostgreSQL journey into independently provable claims so partial success cannot be described as a complete migration.

milestones.title: DB2 Semantic Adapter Hardening
milestones.customer_value: Brings DB2 for z/OS into the same semantic adapter contract and retains stored-logic work as bounded supporting evidence.

milestones.title: COBOL Qualification Hardening
milestones.customer_value: Defines what the platform can and cannot claim across the discovered COBOL estate and separates static qualification from native execution.

milestones.title: PL/I Qualification Hardening
milestones.customer_value: Expands and governs PL/I evidence across language semantics and mainframe integration boundaries.

milestones.title: JCL Qualification Hardening
milestones.customer_value: Qualifies a bounded JCL discovery and semantic subset while keeping JES, catalog, scheduler, and restart claims evidence-dependent.

milestones.title: CICS and VSAM Qualification Hardening
milestones.customer_value: Combines inventory, semantic conformance, and a bounded differential proof for transactional file behavior.

milestones.title: IMS Qualification Hardening
milestones.customer_value: Qualifies bounded IMS database structure, navigation, status, mutation, checkpoint, and restart semantics.

milestones.title: HLASM Qualification Hardening
milestones.customer_value: Qualifies a bounded assembler subset and its COBOL handoff while explicitly excluding native assembler, binder, timing, and privileged-service claims.

milestones.title: Integrated Pilot Qualification
milestones.customer_value: Proves that independently qualified COBOL, PL/I, JCL, DB2, and HLASM subsets compose into one governed customer-shaped pilot.

milestones.title: Oracle Source and Stored-Procedure Qualification
milestones.customer_value: Upgrades the database proof with a genuine Oracle source adapter, SCN-bound resume, semantic-loss analysis, and bounded procedure translation.

milestones.title: Milestone Documentation System
milestones.customer_value: Turns the engineering history into a consistent customer-ready and auditable body of record across Markdown, Word, and PDF.
deliverables: Forty-four canonical milestone narratives covering MS #1 through MS #44.
Matching Markdown, DOCX, and PDF artifacts for every milestone.
A customer-facing index with direct links to every format.
A deterministic generator and content-addressed artifact manifest.
A fail-closed verifier that detects missing, changed, stale, or extra milestone artifacts.
Roadmap governance that reserves MS #45 for the SAP ASE semantic source adapter.
boundaries: The documents explain and package existing evidence; they do not create new technical qualification or live-system evidence.
A customer-facing narrative does not override the underlying receipts, ledgers, gates, or explicit false claims.
Regeneration is required whenever the catalog, changelog, or documentation generator changes.
